Writing Kit

You open the wrap and smooth a clean page beside the ink.

Rules

ID: item-writing-kit

Market price: 6 coins. Bulk: 1.

Ink, paper and pen as a d6 supply. Check once per substantial writing or mapping session, not each sentence. No automatic map accuracy or scholarly knowledge.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
